description: Get the API key's own balance, Compute Units (CU), rate limits, and key parameters from GET /v1/account using your BlockVectra API key. Free and unbilled. Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration (never pass keys in tool parameters or chat). Returns the account's key_id, plan, balance_units, balance_cu, balance_as_of_age_ms, and key limits.
name: get_account
title: Get Account Balance and Limits
